capabilities: Sync Skyreader highlights and notes into the vault
Create one note per article with link, author, dates, DOI or arXiv id
Update only the marked synced section of each note
Choose to sync all highlights or only saves from selected Shelf collections
extras: Full setup guide is hosted elsewhere ("See the guide"); syncing requires a paid Skyreader Supporter plan; the plugin connects to Skyreader via a password created in Skyreader's settings.
problem: Getting highlights, notes and citation details out of the Skyreader reading app into Obsidian notes would otherwise be manual and quickly out of date.

relations.evidence: Keep your Skyreader highlights and notes in your vault: one note per article

summary: Syncs Skyreader reading-app highlights and notes into your vault as one note per article, with citation metadata like DOI or arXiv id.
